query:
UPDATE coaching.requests
                   SET bot_request_id = $1,
                       coachee_id = $2,
                       discord_user_id = $3,
                       discord_username = $4,
                       rank = $5,
                       subrank = $6,
                       hero = $7,
                       games_played = $8,
                       hours_played = $9,
                       availability = $10,
                       scheduled_slot = $11,
                       current_problems = $12,
                       preferred_coach_id = $13,
                       updated_at = $14
                 WHERE website_request_id = $15
